_comment: Seed data for the demo task only. Reference images are rendered wiring DIAGRAMS (render_diagrams.py), not photos; replace them with the expert's photos from a real capture. Tips are placeholder guidance, not quotes from a recording. Wire colors assume red = +24V control, blue = 0V; edit to match the real panel.
title: 24V start/stop circuit
check_context: For this demo the panel may be shown as a wiring diagram on a laptop or monitor screen instead of real hardware. If so, judge the drawing as if it were the real panel: grey boxes are devices on the DIN rail, circles are terminals with their printed labels, and red or blue lines are wires between them.

steps.title: Mount parts on rail
steps.instruction: Clip contactor, Stop, Start and pilot light onto the rail.
tips: Hook the top edge first, then press down until it clicks.
steps.check: Contactor K1, Stop button, Start button and pilot light H1 all clipped on the DIN rail.

steps.title: Wire +24V to Stop
steps.instruction: Run a red wire from +24V to Stop terminal 11.
steps.check: Red wire from the +24V terminal to Stop terminal 11.

steps.title: Link Stop to Start
steps.instruction: Red wire from Stop terminal 12 to Start terminal 13.
steps.check: Red wire from Stop terminal 12 to Start terminal 13.

steps.title: Wire Start to coil
steps.instruction: Red wire from Start terminal 14 to contactor A1.
steps.check: Red wire from Start terminal 14 to contactor terminal A1.

steps.title: Wire coil to 0V
steps.instruction: Blue wire from contactor A2 to the 0V terminal.
steps.check: Blue wire from contactor terminal A2 to the 0V terminal.

steps.title: Wire the pilot light
steps.instruction: Pilot light X1 to A1 red, X2 to A2 blue.
tips: Two wires can share a terminal if both are fully under the clamp.
steps.check: Red wire from pilot light X1 to contactor A1 and blue wire from pilot light X2 to contactor A2.

steps.title: Wire the seal-in contact
steps.instruction: Contactor 13 to Start 13, contactor 14 to A1.
tips: This keeps the coil on after you let go of Start.
steps.check: Red wire from contactor terminal 13 to Start terminal 13, and red wire from contactor terminal 14 to contactor A1.

steps.title: Tug-test every wire
steps.instruction: Pull each wire gently; nothing should move.
tips: A wire that slides out under a light tug will fail in the field.
steps.check: Every wire end fully seated under its terminal clamp; no bare copper visible at any terminal.
